title: 义务教育教科书·英语（译林）五年级下册

units.title: Unit 2
units.theme: How do you come to school?

sentences.en: Bobby and Sam are in the forest.
Why is Liu Tao so happy?

sentences.cn: 苏海，你喜欢你的新家吗？
sentences.en: Do you like your new home, Su Hai?
Where do you live, Yang Ling?

sentences.cn: 王子遇到了一位仙女，因为他心地善良。
sentences.en: The prince meets a fairy, because he is kind.

sentences.cn: 让我在聚会前穿上新衣服。
sentences.en: Let me put on my new clothes before the party.

sentences.cn: 你得试穿这双鞋，也许会合脚。
sentences.en: You have to try on these shoes, and they may fit.
Take off your coat, and don’t be late.

sentences.cn: 别摘那个蘑菇，它对你有害。
sentences.en: Don’t pick the mushroom. It is bad for you.
I understand you.

sentences.cn: 蒂娜，我们上不了公交车了！
sentences.en: We can’t get on the bus, Tina!
My home is far from the city.

sentences.cn: 我学校附近有一条大街。
sentences.en: There is a big street near my school.

sentences.cn: 我步行上学，我爸爸坐地铁。
sentences.en: I come to school on foot, and my father goes by metro.

sentences.cn: 我们可以坐出租车或骑自行车去。
sentences.en: We can go by taxi or by bike.

sentences.cn: 飞机、轮船和火车都很快。
sentences.en: A plane, a ship and a train are all fast.

sentences.cn: 我喜欢骑自行车，还骑给弟弟看。
sentences.en: I like to ride my bike and show it to my young brother.
Put the apples in the basket.
The moon is bright at night.
How do I get to your home, Su Hai?
How does Yang Ling get to Su Hai’s home?

sentences.cn: 我们怎么去城市电影院？
sentences.en: How do we get to City Cinema?
Su Hai is ill.
Excuse me, I want to ask the way.

sentences.cn: 坐公共汽车，在车站上车。
sentences.en: Take the bus and get on at the station.

sentences.cn: 在下一站下车，然后沿着这条街走。
sentences.en: Get off at the next stop, and walk along this street.

sentences.cn: 在红绿灯处向左转，然后向右转。
sentences.en: Turn left at the traffic light, then turn right.
The bookshop is next to the hospital.
The shop is on your right.
The supermarket is near the zoo.
The bus is full.
The sun is bright, and the film is over.
What should I do, Doctor?
What is wrong with Tim?
It is Saturday morning.
We’re watching TV too!
What are Tim and Jim doing?
What should we give Mum?
I have a toothache, so I go to see the doctor.
The dentist will check my teeth.

sentences.cn: 我感觉不舒服，应该吃药、多喝水。
sentences.en: I feel bad. I should take medicine and drink water.

sentences.cn: 休息一下，睡前把牙刷了。
sentences.en: Have a rest and brush your teeth at bedtime.

sentences.cn: 长颈鹿的脖子很长，男孩指着它。
sentences.en: The giraffe has a long neck, and the boy points at it.
Is there anything in your bag?

sentences.cn: 迈克和海伦在帮父母干活吗？
sentences.en: Are Mike and Helen helping their parents?
I can’t wait, Dad!

sentences.cn: 妈妈很忙，所以我帮她打扫房间。
sentences.en: My mother is busy, so I help her clean the room.
I sweep the floor and wash the dishes.
Dad cooks, and I make the bed.

sentences.cn: 我们在花园里种甜甜的西红柿。
sentences.en: We grow sweet tomatoes in the garden.

sentences.cn: 瓢虫不是害虫，别让它走掉。
sentences.en: A ladybird is not a pest, so do not let it go away.
A leaf falls on the garden.
I’m cooking meat with potatoes, Taotao.

sentences.cn: 刘涛正在冰箱里找果汁。
sentences.en: Liu Tao is looking for some juice in the fridge.
Liu Tao is eating the meat.
Does Liu Tao like the meat?

sentences.cn: 比赛准备好了，我们想赢。
sentences.en: The game is ready, and we want to win.

sentences.cn: 汤闻起来很香，面包很好吃。
sentences.en: The soup smells good, and the bread is yummy.

sentences.cn: 我喜欢西红柿、土豆这类蔬菜。
sentences.en: I love vegetables like the tomato and the potato.
Yeah! We catch the ball.

sentences.cn: 那只狗有一块黑斑，它生气了。
sentences.en: The dog has a black spot, and it is angry.
The Spring Festival is in January or February.
The Dragon Boat Festival is in May or June.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is in September or October.
The Lantern Festival is usually in February.
Do you know Mother’s Day, Bobby?
It is Mother’s Day today.
What do people do on Mother’s Day?
Is there a Father’s Day too?
When’s the Spring Festival?

sentences.cn: 我们叫它中国农历新年，全家人团聚在一起。
sentences.en: We call it Chinese New Year, and the family get together.

sentences.cn: 我们在农历新年吃饺子。
sentences.en: We eat jiaozi at Chinese New Year.

sentences.cn: 端午节我们看赛龙舟，吃粽子。
sentences.en: At the Dragon Boat Festival we watch the dragon boat race and eat rice dumplings.
At the Mid-Autumn Festival we eat moon cakes.

sentences.cn: 重阳节我们爬山，吃重阳糕。
sentences.en: At the Double Ninth Festival we climb the mountain and eat rice cakes.

sentences.cn: 我年迈的爷爷最喜欢十一月。
sentences.en: My old grandpa likes November best.

sentences.cn: 十一月是我最喜欢的月份，这是个好地方。
sentences.en: November is my favourite month, and this is a good place.
He’s going to China in March!

sentences.cn: 春天在三月、四月和五月。
sentences.en: Spring is in March, April and May.

sentences.cn: 苏海和迈克在生日那天做什么？
sentences.en: What do Su Hai and Mike do on their birthdays?
How can I open the door?

sentences.cn: 杨玲的生日是什么时候？
sentences.en: When is Yang Ling’s birthday?

sentences.cn: 刘涛的生日是什么时候？
sentences.en: When is Liu Tao’s birthday?
My birthday is on the eighth of July.

sentences.cn: 她的生日在八月十一日。
sentences.en: Her birthday is on the eleventh of August.
The fourth month is April.

sentences.cn: 十二月我们一起玩游戏。
sentences.en: We play a game together in December.

sentences.cn: 英雄开始和坏人打起来。
sentences.en: The hero starts to fight the bad man.

sentences.cn: 密码是什么？答案是一个数字。
sentences.en: What is the password? The answer is a number.
